length_check.note: The chord test cannot change any prediction: the largest eligible undirected chord lower bound is well under the protocol maximum, so even a 20% chord error cannot reach it.

limitations: The study is retrospective: the observations existed before the model.
Road, ship and air observations are not independent votes across direction pairs, midpoint repeats or repeated openings of the same package.
Ship and air can only be checked for positive consistency; their evidence contains no observed failures.
A failure is an observed failure of that exact request under that exact protocol, never evidence that a place cannot support the mode.

air.note: one class only: the retained evidence for this mode contains successful requests and no observed failures. The arithmetic precision is therefore trivially 1 and no discrimination among the frozen rules is estimable.

ship.note: one class only: the retained evidence for this mode contains successful requests and no observed failures. The arithmetic precision is therefore trivially 1 and no discrimination among the frozen rules is estimable.
